description: A vehicle is changing owners within a family, and the paperwork, inspection status, title transfer, plates, and insurance timing need to stay aligned without leaving a gap in legal status.

user_profile.persona: 49-year-old parent transferring a vehicle to an adult child
user_profile.context: The transfer seems simple socially but involves several steps that have to line up correctly
user_profile.communication_style: Administrative and careful, wants a clean handoff with no missed documents
